evaluation_basis: Assessed as a benchmark and integrity layer: development fits, validation selects model and abstention threshold, and test is inspected only after freeze. Protocol existence is not economic proof.
original_objective: Turn frozen v0.20 strategy events into causal labeled samples and compare broad classifier/regressor families as an abstention meta-layer.

engineering_result.summary: Dataset construction, leakage bans, model zoo, validation-only threshold selection, frozen champion output and fail-closed PAPER gate are implemented and regression-tested.

scientific_result.summary: The audit showed severe class imbalance and timeframe-dependent label geometry; raw accuracy was explicitly rejected as the selection objective.

economic_result.summary: The repository record available to this ledger does not contain a canonical completed tournament result proving that a frozen meta-model cleared the post-cost test gate.

provenance.strength: SOURCE_CODE_PROTOCOL_AND_TESTS; CANONICAL RESULT IDENTIFIERS NOT RECORDED

limitations: No canonical completed result identifiers in the reviewed record
Meta-label performance cannot be inferred from implementation
Class imbalance makes raw accuracy misleading
Deep sequence and RL families deliberately excluded
contribution_to_next_version: Established causal event-level ML and reusable frozen features before testing unsupervised, temporal and visual representations.
